name: The Kaldorei Empire
shortDescription: The civilization that arose around the Well of Eternity, mastered its arcane energies, and expanded swiftly across ancient Kalimdor.
body: The kaldorei grew powerful around the Well of Eternity through their mastery of its arcane energies. Their rapid expansion changed the balance among the ancient peoples of Kalimdor and set the stage for the empire that faced the War of the Ancients.
